approved.en: Ukraine and Russia are exchanging intensified strikes as Ukraine hits a St Petersburg plant that produces missile fuel and a Russian refinery in Saratov, while Russia conducts missile and drone attacks on Ukrainian power facilities and the Northern Bridge. Both sides have also targeted energy infrastructure in other regions, with Russian strikes damaging the Ukrainian power grid and Ukrainian attacks damaging Russia’s second-largest refinery, prompting Rosneft to cap sales. Russia has begun rationing petrol after the Ukrainian refinery attacks, and a Russian FPV drone wounded three energy workers in Sumy Oblast amid widespread outages. The United Nations Security Council is monitoring the situation as peace talks are set to begin in Abu Dhabi, and the UCDP recorded 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024.

A sand embankment collapsed in Gaza, killing a woman and injuring several people. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israeli strikes have wounded a Lebanese footballer and led to the detention of a 65-year-old retired engineer. Protests against Israeli attacks on Palestine and Lebanon have taken place in Sweden. The United Nations reports 300,000 people displaced in Lebanon, and there were 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces continue a month-long siege of Taiz while Yemeni government troops have taken the al-Jawf mountain range, intensifying front-line fighting. In Riyadh, Houthi rockets damaged the Saudi Aramco tower in the financial district and the Saudi-led coalition intercepted a Houthi cruise missile, a long-range anti-tank guided missile and downed a ballistic missile aimed at Medina. A Saudi strike near Sanaa killed 22 civilians, mostly women and children, and a Houthi-claimed airstrike near the capital also killed 22 people. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Riyadh ble Saudi Aramco-tårnet i finansdistriktet skadet av houthi-raketter, og den saudisk-ledede koalisjonen avskjærte et houthi-kryssmissil, et langdistanse-antitank-styrt missil og skjøt ned et ballistisk missil rettet mot Medina. Et saudisk angrep nær Sanaa drepte 22 sivile, hovedsakelig kvinner og barn, og et houthi-påstått luftangrep nær hovedstaden drepte også 22 personer. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Syrian forces are reported to be moving troops and advisers toward the Saudi Arabia-Yemen border, while Saudi Arabia is hosting 600 Syrian forces amid fighting with the Houthis. A Syrian sailor was killed while smuggling to the Houthis in Yemen, and a Syrian pharmaceutical tycoon was kidnapped in broad daylight in Aleppo. Israeli violations in southern Syria sparked protests, and anti-Druze hate messages have doubled after elections, spread by pro-government accounts. Syrian forces entered the Roj camp ahead of foreign repatriations, and clashes between two families in Aleppo caused deaths and injuries. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

En syrisk sjømann ble drept mens han smuglet til houthiene i Jemen, og en syrisk farmasøytisk milliardær ble kidnappet i fullt dagslys i Aleppo. Israelske overtredelser i sørlige Syria utløste protester, og hatmeldinger mot drusere har doblet seg etter valgene, spredt av pro-regjeringskontoer. Syriske styrker gikk inn i Roj-leiren før utenlandske repatrieringer, og sammenstøt mellom to familier i Aleppo førte til dødsfall og skadde. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

A former interior minister from the al-Bashir regime has been arrested, and Ahmed Haroun appeared on a podcast, prompting legal commentary. The IOM says 2,500 people have fled villages in North Darfur, and 4,680 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Heavy fighting between government forces and opposition resulted in 23 deaths in recent clashes. South Sudan released the bodies of two Ugandan truck drivers killed in an ambush, a commissioner in Mayom County and his family were assassinated, and a soldier and a civilian were killed in a Kapoeta North attack. Governors in Jonglei and Aweil East called for peace and justice after violence in Uror and two killings, local peace talks began in Tonj East to end communal violence, churches report disruption of worship due to deadly communal clashes, and the ICRC reported ongoing sexual violence. Two battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

Sør-Sudan frigjorde likene til to ugandiske lastebilsjåfører som ble drept i et bakholdsangrep, en kommissær i Mayom fylke og hans familie ble myrdet, og en soldat og en sivil ble drept i et angrep i Kapoeta Nord. Guvernører i Jonglei og Aweil Øst oppfordret til fred og rettferdighet etter vold i Uror og to drap, lokale fredssamtaler startet i Tonj Øst for å få slutt på kommunal vold, kirker melder om forstyrrelser i gudstjenester på grunn av dødelige kommunale sammenstøt, og IKRK rapporterte om pågående seksuell vold. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian drones are now conducting operations in Sudan while RSF drones launch from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, prompting reciprocal diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. In northern Ethiopia, an RPG strike near a school in Moyale killed dozens of Ethiopian Orthodox believers and a Kenyan, leading to additional police deployment and security talks. Attacks on Orthodox Christians continue in Arsi, Benishangul Gumuz and the north, and blasts have been heard in Addis Ababa. Seed insecurity threatens Tigray farmers and a psychosocial and spiritual care pilot is being tested. The war caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Etiopiske droner utfører nå operasjoner i Sudan mens RSF-militsen lanserer droner fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som fører til gjensidige diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. I Nord-Etiopia drepte et RPG-angrep nær en skole i Moyale dusinvis av etiopiske ortodokse troende og en kenyaner, noe som førte til ytterligere politideployering og sikkerhetsdialoger. Angrep på ortodokse kristne fortsetter i Arsi, Benishangul-Gumuz og i nord, og eksplosjoner er hørt i Addis Ababa. Sikkerhetsproblemer for frø truer bønder i Tigray, og et pilotprosjekt for psykososial og åndelig omsorg blir testet. Krigen forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Government troops were attacked near Leego town, and the Somali police deputy chief warned of a security vacuum as Ugandan troops withdraw. Egypt, Somalia and Djibouti held talks on Red Sea security and Horn of Africa stability, and the conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Regjeringsstyrker ble angrepet nær byen Leego, og den somaliske politiets nestleder advarte om et sikkerhetsvakuum når ugandiske tropper trekker seg tilbake.
